tests.description: validation of non-string idn-email values
all string formats ignore integers
all string formats ignore floats
all string formats ignore objects
all string formats ignore arrays
all string formats ignore booleans
all string formats ignore nulls
idn-email format
invalid idn-email string is only an annotation by default
validation of an internationalized e-mail addresses
a valid idn e-mail (example@example.test in Hangul)
an invalid e-mail/idn e-mail address
a valid e-mail address
a non-ASCII local part with an ASCII domain is valid
a non-ASCII quoted local part is valid
a domain label that is not in Unicode NFC is valid
a local part that is not in Unicode NFC is valid
a C1 control in the local part is valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6531#section-3.3 atext =/ UTF8-non-ascii; https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3629#section-4 UTF8-2 admits U+0085

tests.description: a noncharacter in the local part is valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6531#section-3.3 atext =/ UTF8-non-ascii; https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3629#section-4 UTF8-3 admits U+FFFF

tests.description: a local part at the 64-octet limit is valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.5.3.1 every implementation must be able to receive a local part of 64 octets

tests.description: a fullwidth commercial at is not a local-part separator
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Mailbox = Local-part "@" ( Domain / address-literal ) splits on U+0040, and any IDN mapping applies only to the domain that split produces, so U+FF20 cannot become the delimiter

tests.description: a local part with a supplementary-plane character is valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6531#section-3.3 atext =/ UTF8-non-ascii, and https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3629#section-4 UTF8-4 covers U+10000 and above

tests.description: a dot before the local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Dot-string = Atom *("." Atom), so a local part cannot start with a dot

tests.description: a dot after the local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Dot-string = Atom *("." Atom), so a local part cannot end with a dot

tests.description: two subsequent dots inside the local part are not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Atom = 1*atext, so there is no empty atom between two dots

tests.description: two non-ASCII atoms separated by a dot are valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6531#section-3.3 atext =/ UTF8-non-ascii, and https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Dot-string = Atom *("." Atom)

tests.description: an unquoted space in the local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 a space is not atext

tests.description: a quoted non-ASCII local part with a space is valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 qtextSMTP includes %d32, and https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6531#section-3.3 adds qtextSMTP =/ UTF8-non-ascii

tests.description: a quoted non-ASCII local part with an @ is valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 qtextSMTP includes %d64, and https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6531#section-3.3 adds qtextSMTP =/ UTF8-non-ascii

tests.description: two unquoted @ signs are not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 "@" is not atext, so an unquoted local part cannot contain one

tests.description: a comma in an unquoted local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 "," is not atext

tests.description: a comment in the local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Mailbox has no CFWS; comments are RFC 5322 syntax

tests.description: an unclosed double quote in the local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Quoted-string = DQUOTE *QcontentSMTP DQUOTE

tests.description: text after the closing double quote is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Local-part = Dot-string / Quoted-string, so a quoted local part ends at its closing DQUOTE

tests.description: an unescaped double quote in an unquoted local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 DQUOTE is not atext

tests.description: a tab in the local part is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 HTAB is not atext

tests.description: local part is required
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Local-part = Dot-string / Quoted-string, and a Dot-string has at least one atext

tests.description: an empty string is not valid
a domain label starting with a hyphen is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 sub-domain = Let-dig [Ldh-str], so a label starts with a letter or digit; RFC 6531 section 3.3 only adds sub-domain =/ U-label

tests.description: a domain label ending with a hyphen is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Ldh-str = *( ALPHA / DIGIT / "-" ) Let-dig, so a label ends with a letter or digit

tests.description: a domain starting with a dot is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Domain = sub-domain *("." sub-domain) admits no empty sub-domain

tests.description: a domain ending with a dot is not valid
two subsequent dots inside the domain are not valid
a single-label non-ASCII domain is valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Domain = sub-domain *("." sub-domain) allows a single sub-domain, and https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6531#section-3.3 adds sub-domain =/ U-label

tests.description: a space in the domain is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 a space is not allowed in a sub-domain, and is not valid in a U-label

tests.description: a domain label with a character IDNA2008 disallows is not valid
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5892#section-2.6 U+302E is DISALLOWED, so the label is not a U-label (RFC 6531 section 3.3 sub-domain =/ U-label)

tests.description: domain is required
tests.comment: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5321#section-4.1.2 Mailbox = Local-part "@" ( Domain / address-literal )
